description: Identify a track by its ADNA fingerprint (anti-plagiarism; verdict same/derivative/different) or fetch track data by ISRC from the Stage 0 registry. v2 (adna_v2) adds localization: offset_sec, coverage, attribution map for multi-sample tracks

adna.description: ADNA v1 fingerprint (base64, 256 bytes ≈ 344 chars) — run through the oracle

adna_v2.description: ADNA v2 fingerprint (base64, starts with QTI; windowed signatures, ~KB scale) — aligned identification: finds fragments, cut-offs, pitch ±8%

name: identify_track
